activity: Observed traffic only; no assistant page probes, browser tabs, SSE replay or synthetic load generated in this analysis. Read-only Jaeger, log, GitHub and one numbering DB check.
limitations: Not all process logs are timestamped; exporter intentionally filters spans. This is available captured traffic, not proof of every click or all runtime work.
Cannot distinguish physical clicks, prefetch and automatic refresh; no browser click-to-ready signal.
Route patterns do not identify project or numeric-versus-Next detail.
Three roots with late children are excluded from primary latency statistics; abort/cancellation is not proven.
Project/draft sizes vary and background work changes; no controlled causal before/after claim.
No application code, events, service lifecycle, GitHub issue or PR state changed.
